Table issue: T3/T4 share one apex (0.3446/0.3511, R 38 right), T5/T6 one left, and T10–T13 are four fracs inside one 0.78–0.81 sweep. Meanwhile measured curvature peaks at 0.2261 (R 91 m), 0.2528 (R 120 m), 0.5451 (R 77 m) and 0.5959 (R 73 m) have no turns entry. The turns numbering therefore does not map to the real T1–T14 names in the brief. Apex-keyed consumers (bankZones turn:2/8/14, sector/corner labels, AI corner data) inherit the offset. (catalunya.js turns line; bankZones comments say "turn 2 = Elf (T1)".)

6. Ranked defects (suggestions only, nothing applied)

#SevDefect (where seen)Cause (file:line) / suggested fix
D1HighThe hero main grandstand shows no seating from the track side: a plain beige wall with a dark band (frames 01 orbit and eye, every weather/tod).scenery/catalunya.js:140-169: the modelGroup shell (box centre r+4, width 10, 11 m tall from gap 14 → spans roughly gap 13–24 m, line 156) most likely sits in front of or on top of the grandstandEx seating (gap 11, line 140), hiding the raked tiers. Mechanism not verified by geometry dump. Fix: move the shell behind the seating (gap ≥ 24) or drop one of the two stands; keep only the canopy and glazing from the modelGroup.
D2HighOvercast and fog frames keep a saturated clear-blue sky; the ground fogs but the sky does not grey.js/lighting/atmosphere.js:376-380 (clear-weather-only branch) vs the wet/rain branch at 355-393, which does overcast the sky. Rain/storm are correct; overcast/fog have no sky desaturation. Engine fix: grey zenith/horizon for overcast and fog. Not circuit-specific, but Catalunya's strongly saturated pal.zenith [.20,.42,.76] makes it obvious. Also relevant to wet.
D3MedDay-dry sky is a flat deep blue to the horizon with no visible warm horizon haze, despite pal.horizon [.80,.80,.72] and the brief's "bleached" look; low-contrast bright scene feels flat.catalunya.js pal; sky shader/horizon blend not examined. Check whether horizon reaches the sky pass; consider raising fogColor density at distance.
D4MedStone-pine (umbrella) canopies go near-black in rain and storm while cone cypress/pines stay green.Frames day-rain 02/03, day-storm. stonePine at scenery/catalunya.js:398 → build-props.js:1743. Likely a material/ambient response in the wet darkening; compare with the pine path. Unconfirmed mechanism.
D5MedWet/rain reflections of lamp posts and canopies are drawn as vertical ghost streaks over grass and dirt, not just on tarmac.Frames day-wet 02–05, day-rain. Reflection pass treats off-road terrain as reflective; renderer-side (js/render/three), out of the circuit's scope. Report to the renderer owner.
D6MedLamp/floodmast heads read as oversized flat slabs, and a mast head fills the frame at 0.50 orbit.catalunya.js:311-316 floodMast 40 m, arms 3, light:false; the 6 masts do nothing at night (no authored night). Either give Catalunya real floodlights (a night race is not planned: night:false) or remove or push out the nearest mast (0.030 L, gap 24 m).
D7LowThe pit-bay roofs and the area left of the S/F line render as a huge flat untextured grey plane (frame 01, all weathers; unlit navy slab at night).catalunya.js:78-108 roof slab 19×30 m ×6, WHITE, no detail; at night it receives no light so reads as void. Add roof edge, vents or a MAT with sheen; low priority.
D8LowThe turns table has duplicate/missing apexes (see §2) and the def comment says a 700 m main straight (measured 992 m; brief 1,047 m).js/circuits/catalunya.js turns and the startFrac comment. Re-derive turns with tools/track/rotate-markings.cjs and the researched real turn list, keep bank/hw zone indices in step.

7. Code & scenery deep-dive

  • Frame conventions: no sceneryStartFrac (comment at def lines 14-17: residual shift 0, a 0.03 value would stand the pit block 0.055 short of T1); all frac tables in scenery/catalunya.js are in the def's own frame and go through K()/along()/anchor(), so _sceneryShift is respected. No raw frac into a frac-keyed engine table was found.
  • Exclusions: dressingExclusions keeps foliage out of 0.92–0.12 and 0.558–0.658; the scenery's own openInfield (line 50) repeats the same windows, so a change must be made in both places.
  • Terrain: terrainOuter: 115; no flatTerrain. Terraces use drape() (res 0.08) to sit on the hillside; ridges are generated from lapBounds() rather than authored.
  • Real-world cross-check (from the brief, URLs there): Tilke main stand 2002, ~9,580 seats (tilke.de); railway parallel to the main stand (racingcircuits.info); Europcar/T12 stands removed Dec 2017 (not rebuilt: correct). Heights, lengths and the scoreboard proportions are marked approximate in the source. I did not re-verify these online.
  • Layout: built length −0.1 % vs real, T1 right-hander and overall clockwise sense match. The longest straight measures 992 m against the brief's ~1,047 m; the gap is plausibly the curvature threshold, not a layout error.
  • Required landmarks: 9 modelGroups carry { required: true } in source; the landmarks contract test was not run here.

8. Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut from the matrix: trackside and aerial views, EYE for every weather/tod, dawn, night fog/overcast/storm, dusk storm (66 frames only; no frame is a retake).
  • No pixel-level proof for D1's mechanism (no geometry dump), D3, D4 causes.
  • Banking values as built (bankP) and surveyed-elevation override not inspected.
  • OSM / real-world comparison not run; path comment says the upstream trace winds CCW while the brief says clockwise; the rendered T1 right-hander suggests the built lap is clockwise.
  • Race-start grid cars appear in some frames (wet 0.17); not a defect.
  • Frames are SwiftShader/TLX only; no WGX or GLX comparison, no hardware GPU.
  • graph-parity not run (no TrackGraph migration was in scope).
